verdict.rationale: Real-time multi-user sync is a fair question for a collaborative project-management tool, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents live propagation of teammates' edits across open sessions without a refresh. The nearest items are integration-driven updates from GitHub/GitLab and Docs Suggestion Mode, which are adjacent features, not real-time session sync.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can see teammates' changes reflected instantly across open sessions without refreshing
